scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly eventually periodic integer sequences obeying an order-at-most-two homogeneous recurrence and having no zero terms. It does not resolve binomid integrality or divisibility for non-eventually-periodic second-order recurrences.
title: A sharp four-row binomid test for eventually periodic second-order recurrences
